channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Nvidia board focuses on investigation, no discussion of bringing back Jensen Huang as search continues for new CEO
item.description: Nvidia’s board says it is focused on investigating co-founder Jensen Huang’s ties to a Chinese business executive and has not discussed his possible return as CEO. The company is searching for a successor, with reports naming Arm chief Rene Haas as a potential candidate.&nbsp;

item.title: Mahanadi Coalfields seeks ₹90,000 crore valuation in ₹8,981 crore IPO
item.description: The share sale will open to institutional and retail investors on 19 November and close on 23 November, with a stock market listing expected on 27 November.

item.title: US FMCG major Church & Dwight plans India launch with premium products for online customers
item.description: The maker of Arm &amp; Hammer home care goods and Trojan condoms is aiming for an early-2027 launch in India with four products across niches including acne patches and dry shampoo.

item.title: PB Balaji drove Tata Motors out of debt. JLR is dragging it back in
item.description: After a debt-free demerger, Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles is back in debt, burning cash, and facing mounting pressure on profitability, largely due to its British subsidiary Jaguar Land Rover.

item.title: Nvidia faces extraordinary push to restore Huang days after his exit
item.description: NVIDIA-CEO-SUPPORT:Nvidia faces extraordinary push to restore Huang days after his exit

item.title: Amazon vows to fight the companys first North American union contract at a Canadian warehouse
item.description: Amazon vows to fight the company's first North American union contract at a Canadian warehouse

item.title: L3Harris Finds Itself Back in the Spotlight After ATC Meltdown
item.description: L3Harris Technologies Inc. faces renewed scrutiny after US officials said the company may have been at fault for a nationwide grounding of all flights Friday evening, the latest corporate drama to befall the defense giant in recent months.

item.title: IDBI-Fairfax deal | Bank staff unions press RBI to block takeover, announce December 3 strike: What are their concerns?
item.description: IDBI Bank employee unions have asked the RBI to advise the government and LIC to suspend the disinvestment process and abandon the proposed transfer of control to a foreign entity.

item.title: NCDRC upholds ₹20 lakh fine on Exporters India for listing explosive substances
item.description: Rejecting the B2B portal’s intermediary defence, the panel ruled that online marketplaces cannot bypass due diligence when hosting regulated and hazardous products.

item.title: JLR's China sales plunge 45% in Q2 FY27; North America turns key growth engine
item.description: JLR chief executive PB Balaji said domestic Chinese manufacturers were increasingly challenging established luxury carmakers through technology, vehicle interiors, design and competitive pricing.

item.title: Jensen Huang’s return bid hits wall: US Treasury chief Scott Bessent pushes Nvidia board to hire outsider CEO
item.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has called for a ‘dramatic’ leadership change at the chipmaker, urging its board to look outside the company for a successor.

item.title: Who is Arun Nambiar? Former X India business head joins Uber Advertising to lead national agency strategy
item.description: Arun Nambiar, former X India Business Head at Aleph Group, has joined Uber Advertising as Head of Agency, India. He will lead national agency strategy and partnerships. Nambiar previously held advertising and sales roles at X, Twitter, Httpool, Sony Pictures Networks India and Disney.

item.title: RBI moves review plea in Supreme Court against Yes Bank AT-1 bond ruling
item.description: Yes Bank had also filed a review petition on 13 November, making it the second party to seek a review of the Supreme Court’s judgment.

item.title: Hindustan Zinc’s ₹80,000-crore expansion: The big bet to double its metal output and ride India’s infrastructure boom
item.description: The company's board of directors approved the HZL 2.0 Growth Programme, which will increase its existing metal production capacity of 1.1 MTPA by approximately 1 MTPA.

item.title: BITS Pilani raises ₹507 crore for endowment fund in 23 months, eyes ₹939 crore target: Group VC V Ramgopal Rao
item.description: Annual alumni donations also touched a record ₹82 crore in the financial year 2025-26, registering a 43% increase over the previous year. The amount is nearly 90 times the annual contributions recorded when the Alumni Relations Office was established in FY18.

item.title: Sri Lankan firm bags $75 million NTPC contract to set up 57 MW Andaman power plant: All you need to know
item.description: Sri Lankan firm Lakdhanavi has secured a $75 million contract from India's NTPC to build a 57 MW power plant at Hope Town in Port Blair. The project aims to strengthen the islands' electricity infrastructure, improve energy security through LNG infrastructure and support economic development.

item.title: Amazon loses 40 internet satellites after Boeing-Lockheed’s Vulcan rocket fails- Here’s what happened
item.description: Amazon, meanwhile, acknowledged the risks associated with space launches and expressed confidence in its launch partner.

item.title: Elon Musk, Tim Sweeney want Jensen Huang back at Nvidia as CEO: Who else is backing his return? Full list
item.description: Elon Musk, Tim Sweeney, Garry Tan and several major investors are backing Jensen Huang's possible return as Nvidia CEO. An online campaign has gathered over 158,000 signatures as the company faces a leadership crisis.

item.title: What to know about Super Micro Computer as Singapore probes alleged diversion of Nvidia AI servers to China
item.description: The case has acquired fresh significance amid growing scrutiny of how restricted Nvidia AI chips continue to reach Chinese entities despite Washington's export restrictions.

item.title: Who is Madison Huang? Why Jensen Huang’s daughter is in spotlight at Nvidia amid CEO succession speculation
item.description: Madison Huang, daughter of Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang, is attracting attention amid the company's leadership transition. From training as a chef and working in luxury marketing to leading physical AI product marketing at Nvidia, could her growing role put her in spotlight amid succession debate?

item.title: FSSAI gives Red Bull 7 days to justify its 'energy drink' label, seeks explanation over sugar content
item.description: The notice gives Red Bull seven days to explain why India should not prohibit its use of the ‘energy drink’ label.

item.title: TVS family feud takes legal turn as Lakshmi stakes her claim
item.description: The dispute within the TVS family is moving toward court after Lakshmi Venu sent her father a legal notice seeking a fair share of family assets. She says no division of her immediate family’s property was completed and alleges her brother Sudarshan received preferential treatment.

item.title: Multiple affairs and a federal investigation: Why Nvidia and Silicon Valley want Jensen Huang back
item.description: Nvidia’s board released a statement saying it was hiring an executive search firm, but it had not yet engaged any potential candidates. However, despite the controversies and federal probe, there have been several calls to reinstate Huang as the CEO of Nvidia.

item.title: Jio vs Airtel vs Vi - which telecom operator had the fewest spam call complaints? What TRAI data says
item.description: TRAI reported that telecom operators’ AI systems flagged 19.9 billion calls and SMSes as suspected spam in July–September 2026. The regulator received 1.529 million complaints, took enforcement action against more than 124,000 telecom resources and blacklisted 374 senders.

item.title: How a big red truck became a celebrity in India’s heartland
item.description: The monster transporter hauling a 40-metre-long, nine-metre-wide metal cylinder weighing 180 tonnes went viral as the Bahubali truck in September.

item.title: Amid ‘bring back Jensen Huang’ chorus, a look at CEOs who made dramatic returns to firms they were ousted from | List
item.description: Jensen Huang may seek to return as Nvidia CEO, according to reports, with influential allies and shareholders supporting the possibility. His potential comeback will mirror those of Steve Jobs at Apple, Sam Altman at OpenAI and Jack Dorsey at Twitter.

item.title: Following Accor split, Treebo targets 3,500-4,000 hotels in five years
item.description: The hotel company is doubling down on the ₹1,000-3,000 room-rate segment, where it sees an opportunity to organize a fragmented market through technology and centralized distribution.

item.title: Tata boardroom battle: Jimmy Tata backs Chandrasekaran, accuses Noel Tata of using Tata Trusts for takeover of Tata Sons
item.description: Jimmy Naval Tata has backed Tata Sons Chairman N. Chandrasekaran amid tensions with Tata Trusts Chairman Noel Tata, calling for the company to be listed. He says listing would improve transparency, accountability and governance, and urges the RBI to set a firm deadline.

item.title: SC upholds NCLAT order to send Videocon insolvency case back for fresh bids
item.description: The challenge centred on how Vedanta group-backed Twin Star proposed to pay dissenting creditors of Videocon and whether the resolution plan complied with the IBC

item.title: SpaceX launch: After Starship’s spectacular midair catch, Musk’s firm to launch Falcon 9 on Thursday
item.description: SpaceX plans to launch the classified USSF-317 mission from California aboard a Falcon 9, with the booster expected to land on a Pacific droneship. The launch follows Starship Flight 15, which achieved the first tower catch of a Starship upper stage.

item.title: AI startup Zelmier.com cuts discovery & bidding of government tenders to minutes
item.description: Founded by young entrepreneur Pranjal Srivastava, the startup aggregates tenders from 250+ prominent government portals and uses AI to match opportunities for businesses

item.title: Anthropic IPO: Why Google’s 13% stake and Big Tech’s $900-billion AI bet hinge on Claude maker’s success | Decoded
item.description: Anthropic’s planned IPO has become a major test for the AI industry, with tech giants investing $26 billion at the expected offering price and holding stakes in the company.&nbsp;

item.title: Indian PE, VC firms gear up to launch fresh funds post record $29.5 billion haul
item.description: PE-VC funds raised a record $29.5 billion in the first 10 months of 2026, drawing new fund launches even as LPs scrutinize realised returns and fund managers more closely.

item.title: Michigan pension fund drags Intel to court after 29% stock plunge in a day wiped out $140 billion in market value
item.description: Intel shareholders have filed a proposed class action, alleging the company concealed how slowing PC sales and excess inventory would hurt revenue. The suit says Intel disclosed the problems too late, before its stock plunged 28.6% in one day, wiping out about $140 billion in market value.
